name: Riverside Village
description: A compact riverside settlement built around a market square, a northern gate, and the Silver River docks.

town_square.name: Town Square
town_square.description: Riverside's cobbled heart. A fountain, quest board, and the village's busiest paths meet here.

north_gate_road.name: North Gate Road
north_gate_road.description: A short guarded road running from the square to Riverside's northern gate.

north_gate.name: North Gate
north_gate.description: A timber gate opens north into the Whispering Woods.

barracks_exterior.name: Guard Barracks
barracks_exterior.description: A practical stone barracks beside the north road.

barracks_interior.name: Inside the Barracks
barracks_interior.description: Orderly bunks, duty rosters, and a captain's map table fill the guard common room.

jail_cell.name: Jail Cell
jail_cell.description: A spare holding cell with a barred window and a heavy locked door.

watchtower_base.name: Watchtower Base
watchtower_base.description: The watchtower's stone base stands directly east of the gate road.

watchtower_top.name: Watchtower - Top
watchtower_top.description: A high platform overlooking the village and the forest road.

tavern_exterior.name: The Drunken Dragon Tavern
tavern_exterior.description: A warm, busy tavern tucked behind the barracks on the north side of town.

tavern_main_floor.name: Tavern - Main Floor
tavern_main_floor.description: Firelight, long tables, and the low hum of conversation fill the taproom.

tavern_upper_floor.name: Tavern - Upper Floor
tavern_upper_floor.description: A quiet upstairs landing with a few simple guest rooms.

tavern_cellar.name: Tavern Cellar
tavern_cellar.description: Cool storage under the tavern; a repaired breach still leads deeper below town.

tavern_kitchen.name: Tavern Kitchen
tavern_kitchen.description: A compact kitchen smelling of bread, onions, and woodsmoke.

east_market_road.name: East Market Road
east_market_road.description: The eastern road carries shoppers from the square into the market row.

market_square.name: Market Square
market_square.description: Canvas stalls and merchants cluster around the village market.

east_gate_road.name: East Gate Road
east_gate_road.description: A clean road leading past the market toward the eastern gate.

east_gate.name: East Gate
east_gate.description: An open gate faces the foothills and the farms beyond.

fish_stall.name: Fish Stall
fish_stall.description: Fresh river catch is laid out on ice beneath a striped awning.

alleyway.name: Narrow Alley
alleyway.description: A service lane behind the market stalls leads toward the river.

general_store_exterior.name: General Store
general_store_exterior.description: A tidy storefront stocked for travelers and households alike.

general_store_interior.name: Inside the General Store
general_store_interior.description: Shelves of tools, preserved food, clothing, and sundries line the walls.

alchemist_exterior.name: Alchemist's Shop
alchemist_exterior.description: Colored bottles gleam in the window of this small market-side shop.

alchemist_interior.name: Inside the Alchemist's Shop
alchemist_interior.description: A crowded workroom of glassware, herbs, and carefully labeled powders.

river_road.name: River Road
river_road.description: A southern lane follows the Silver River from town toward the docks.

riverside_docks.name: Riverside Docks
riverside_docks.description: Small boats and cargo skiffs crowd the village docks.

fishing_hut.name: Fishing Hut
fishing_hut.description: Nets, traps, and a drying rack surround a modest riverside hut.

bridge_approach_west.name: Bridge Approach
bridge_approach_west.description: The western end of the old stone bridge rises over the river.

bridge_middle.name: Middle of the Stone Bridge
bridge_middle.description: The bridge's midpoint offers a clear view along the Silver River.

bridge_approach_east.name: East Bridge Approach
bridge_approach_east.description: The eastern bridge approach opens toward farmland.

museum_exterior.name: Riverside Museum
museum_exterior.description: A small civic museum with a clean stone facade faces the river road.

museum_interior.name: Museum Grand Hall
museum_interior.description: Local finds and carefully restored curiosities fill the museum's hall.

west_lane.name: West Lane
west_lane.description: A quiet threshold lane leading from the square into Riverside's homes and gardens.

residential_street_east.name: Residential Street
residential_street_east.description: Small homes and garden paths line this calmer southwestern street.

player_house_exterior.name: A Small House
player_house_exterior.description: A modest, well-kept house with room to grow into a home.

shrine_exterior.name: Shrine of Healing
shrine_exterior.description: A peaceful shrine stands beside a small herb garden.

shrine_interior.name: Inside the Shrine
shrine_interior.description: The shrine is calm with incense and a narrow stair down to old catacombs.

blacksmith_exterior.name: Blacksmith's Forge
blacksmith_exterior.description: Hammering rings from a sturdy forge at the end of the residential street.

blacksmith_interior.name: Inside the Forge
blacksmith_interior.description: A working forge, tool racks, and a glowing hearth occupy the smithy.
